avis.titre: Thinner light weight product but still a great!
avis.texte: I love the Anua cleansers so I decided to give this moisturizer a try. Upon first impression I found it to be a lot thinner than I was expecting. I typically use brands like clarins or first aide beauty for moisturizer which are a lot thicker however I do have oily skin and it’s currently summer so I feel like a lighter weight moisturizer suits my needs at this time. Upon noticing the thinner consistency I went to check the ingredients expecting the first ingredient to be water and it was actually rice water. I was very pleased to see this because rice water has a lot of benefits. Despite having a thinner consistency than I’m used to I felt that this moisturizer did a good job at hydrating and making my skin feel nice and soft. I have some large pores which I don’t think skincare can really resolve but honestly my skin is looking really good plump and moisturized. I haven’t experienced any breakouts and you cannot beat the price. This is an excellent product and well worth the money. If you have dry skin I would not recommend this. It’s not the richest of moisturizers and I feel you would benefit from something with a thicker formula but I am very happy with my purchase. Thanks Anua!!!

avis.titre: Hydrating, Lightweight, and Perfect for Sensitive Skin!Hydrating, Lightweight, and Perfect for Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: This moisturizer feels amazing on my skin! The texture is lightweight, milky, and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. My skin feels soft, hydrated, and smooth all day after using it. I also love that it contains niacinamide and ceramides because it helps keep my skin barrier healthy and gives my skin a natural glow. It works really well under makeup and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. The bottle lasts a long time, and a little product goes a long way. Overall, this is a great Korean skincare product for anyone looking for hydration and lightweight moisture. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Gives the prettiest healthy glow.Gives the prettiest healthy glow.
avis.texte: This moisturizing milk lives up to the hype. The rice extract + ceramide combo is perfect. It's not a thick cream, it's a light milk that sinks right in. Leaves my skin dewy, not oily. Honestly, this moisturizer is great if you prefer something lightweight and breathable 🌿 It absorbs quickly and doesn’t feel heavy on the skin, which is perfect for those who don’t like thick creams. However, for me personally, I prefer a more deeply moisturizing feel. My skin didn’t feel as hydrated as I wanted it to, especially compared to other products I’ve tried. For example, I’ve been using the Anua PDRN Spray and even though it’s also lightweight, I actually feel more hydration and a noticeable difference in my skin 💦 Pros: ✨ Lightweight and absorbs quickly ✨ Not greasy or heavy ✨ Good for oily/combination skin Cons: 💧 Not deeply hydrating (for dry skin) 💧 May need layering with other products Overall, a decent option for lightweight hydration—but I personally reach for something more moisturizing! 💙

avis.titre: Lightweight hydration that gives a nice glow, but may feel rich for oily skin
avis.texte: This rice milk lotion has a very lightweight, milky texture that spreads easily and absorbs quickly into the skin. It feels soothing and hydrating without being sticky, and it gives a healthy, dewy glow that makes the skin look smooth and refreshed. I like that it contains rice water, niacinamide, and ceramides, which help support the skin barrier and keep the skin feeling soft and nourished. It layers well under sunscreen and makeup and does not pill or feel heavy. For very oily skin types, it might feel a little rich if applied too generously, but for normal to dry or combination skin it works really well. Overall, it is a great everyday moisturizer for achieving a glowy, hydrated look.

avis.titre: BUY IT!! Leaves skin plump and moisturized!
avis.texte: This is my first time using this — so I will give an update later. However, I have been SEARCHING high and low for a moisturizer that leaves my skin glowing, hydrated, soft, and NOT sticky. This checked every single personal requirement!! I used the toner beforehand (after I washed my face with the La Roche Posay foaming cleanser, which is my every day face wash) and then used the toner. I won’t lie, I don’t usually ever use toner, so it was also my first use of that and I have to say it made my skin feel fresher. I WISH I had taken a before photo, but please trust that my skin was kind of … dull and not plump and dewy before this! It is not temporary, I took these photos an hour after washing and applying. Another huge bonus! I definitely think I finally found a permanent solution. It is also lightweight and unscented. Like I said — I will update in a few months considering this is still my first impression! For the cost this was 100% worth every penny.
